about: Issue #1182: the owner's short replies to asks, each a thread and what the triage must do with it. triage.eval.mjs runs each with triage.md and a real model; the check's line is what new-messages.mjs prints for the messages after since. An expected add is matched by why_open, state (left out with why_open: open), whether it has a due (due_date or due_at), and text, a regular expression on its fields.
